key_insight: The paper formalizes a Lean 4 certification pipeline for key number-field invariants, extending trustworthy verification from rings of integers to signature, unit groups modulo p-th powers, discriminants, and class groups.
engineering_relevance: It enables computer algebra systems and databases to produce machine-checked proofs for arithmetic invariants, improving reliability of large-scale number-theory computations.
method: Build reusable Lean 4 structures for certified algebraic objects and ideal arithmetic.
Formalize supporting mathematics, including results on real closed fields and pseudo-remainder sequences.
Use SageMath to compute certificates and generate Lean proofs for the target invariants.
evidence_signal: The framework was applied to verify hundreds of LMFDB entries covering discriminant, signature, class number, and class group structure.
watch_item: Certificate generation depends on the quality and compatibility of the SageMath-to-Lean workflow, which may limit automation for harder or larger-degree cases.
